description: This file contains a PHP class 'ADODB2_postgres' which extends 'ADODB_DataDict' to provide database schema manipulation methods specifically suited for PostgreSQL. It includes methods for type mapping, adding, altering, dropping columns, recreating tables, indexes, and handling sequences.

classes.name: ADODB2_postgres
classes.description: A PHP class that provides PostgreSQL-specific database schema manipulation functionalities, extending the general ADODB_DataDict class.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Maps column data types to internal type codes based on column properties.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Converts internal type codes back to PostgreSQL data types.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to add a new column to a table, handling default values and null constraints.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Creates SQL commands to replace an existing column, necessitating table recreation in PostgreSQL.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop a column, with considerations for PostgreSQL version compatibility.

methods.name: _recreate_copy_table
methods.description: Performs table recreation by copying data to a temporary table, dropping and recreating the original, then restoring data and indexes.

methods.name: DropTableSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop a table and its associated sequences.

methods.name: _CreateSuffix
methods.description: Creates SQL suffixes for column definitions like default values and constraints.

methods.name: _DropAutoIncrement
methods.description: Finds and generates SQL to drop the sequence used for auto-incrementing columns.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Creates SQL statements for creating or dropping indexes.

methods.name: _GetSize
methods.description: Determines the data type string with size and precision for PostgreSQL.
